nodes.summary: Russo's formula in pivotal-factor form: for increasing `A` and `0 < p < 1`, `d/dp ℙ_p(A) = (p(1 - p))⁻¹ ∑_e 𝔼_p[1_A (ω_e - p)]`.
nodes.title: Russo's formula

nodes.summary: The probability `ℙ_p(A)` of `A` under the Bernoulli(`p`) product measure on `{0, 1}^E` for `p ∈ [0, 1]`; outside `[0, 1]` it is the polynomial `StatMech.prob p A`, so that the function is defined on all of `ℝ`.
nodes.title: Probability of an event under Bernoulli product measure

nodes.summary: The indicator `ω_e ∈ {0, 1}` (as a real number) that the edge `e` is open in `ω`.
nodes.title: Real-valued indicator that an edge is open

nodes.summary: Russo's formula for `p : ℝ≥0`, packaged with the identification of `measureProb A p` with `(bernoulliProductMeasure p hp).real A`.
nodes.title: Russo's formula for the Bernoulli product measure

nodes.summary: Russo's formula (Margulis–Russo): for an increasing event `A` on a finite edge set and `0 < p < 1`, `p ↦ ℙ_p(A)` has derivative `∑_e ℙ_p(e is pivotal for A)` at `p`. See also `StatMech.hasDerivAt_prob_eq_sum_pivotalProb` (the polynomial form, for all `p`) and `StatMech.hasDerivAt_realProb_cylinder_pivotal` (cylinder events on an infinite edge set).
nodes.title: Russo's formula

nodes.summary: Russo's formula, `deriv` form: `d/dp ℙ_p(A) = ∑_e ℙ_p(e is pivotal for A)` for an increasing event `A` and `0 < p < 1`.
nodes.title: Russo's formula

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
